name: Workspace Labels
author: Wes (wbuf81)
description: Named workspaces with per-workspace icons — Nerd Font glyphs or real app icons — hover previews, and a + to add or remove workspaces.

barWidget.description: Named workspaces with glyph or app icons. Right-click any workspace to open the editor panel, or press + to add one.

schema.label: Workspace labels
schema.description: Map of workspace number -> {icon, name}. `icon` is a literal glyph, or "app:<icon-name>" to use an installed application's icon (e.g. "app:brave-desktop"). Edited by right-clicking the widget, or `omarchy bar set io.github.wbuf81.workspace-labels labels '<json>' --json`.

schema.label: Hover preview
schema.description: capture shows a single-shot screenshot of every window on the workspace; map draws each window as a block with its app icon and never shows screen content; off disables the preview. Suppressed while the editor is open.

schema.label: Auto icons
schema.description: A workspace without an icon shows the icon of the app running on it, chosen by the most common window class. Turn off to leave icon-less workspaces bare.

schema.label: Hover previews (legacy)
schema.description: Superseded by `previewMode`. Only consulted while `previewMode` is unset: false turns previews off.

schema.label: Pinned workspaces
schema.description: Workspace numbers kept in the bar even when empty. Managed by the + button and the per-row remove in the editor. Workspaces that actually exist always show regardless. If unset, the legacy `minWorkspaces` setting seeds this as 1..N.

schema.label: Always-visible workspaces (legacy)
schema.description: Superseded by `pinned`, which is written the first time you use + or remove. Only consulted while `pinned` is unset, where it pins 1..N.
